segments.sn22.65:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.65:1.3: “sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena … pe … pahitatto vihareyyan”ti.
segments.sn22.65:2.1: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī”ti?
segments.sn22.65:2.9: Imassa khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī”ti.
segments.sn22.65:3.2: Sādhu kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
segments.sn22.65:3.3: Rūpaṃ kho, bhikkhu, abhinandamāno baddho mārassa;
segments.sn22.65:3.10: Imassa kho, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti … pe …
segments.sn22.65:3.11: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.

lines: Sā hi taṇhāyanaṭṭhena taṇhā, chandikataṭṭhena chando.
Catutthaṃ aniccalakkhaṇamukhena vuttaṃ, pañcamaṃ dukkhalakkhaṇamukhena, chaṭṭhaṃ anattalakkhaṇamukhena.
